summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Wedding CRM application. All major features tested and working correctly including dashboard, leads management, settings, quote workflow, client portal, and enquiry form.
passed_tests: Dashboard loads with stats (new leads, active jobs, total invoiced, outstanding)
Leads page - add new lead form works
Settings page - can save business info and bank details
Settings page - can create quote templates
Settings page - can create contract templates
Send quote to a lead from Leads page
Accept quote creates job, invoice, contract, booking form
Client portal accessible via token and displays all info
Client portal contract signing with signature canvas
Client portal booking form can be filled and saved
Enquiry form (/enquiry) submits and creates lead
